Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Major Depressive Disorder according to Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-V)
  -  > 25 years
  -  Sufficient understanding of the German language
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  < 25 years
  -  Concomitant diagnosis of past  [OR] or present psychotic disorder
  -  Concomitant diagnosis of past  [OR] or present bipolar disorder
  -  First degree relative with a psychotic disorder
  -  Unable  [OR] or unwilling to discontinue antidepressant medication
  -  Pregnancy  [OR] or breastfeeding
  -  Known hypersensitivity to LSD
  -  Somatic disorders including central nervous system (CNS) involvement
  -  Known or suspected non-compliance, [OR]  drug  [OR] or alcohol abuse
  -  Metal implants
  -  Weight < 42 kg
  -  Suicide risk  [OR] or very likely to require psychiatric hospitalisation
